name: Proud Tek Editorial Team
shortBio: Institutional byline for Proud Tek's RFID and NFC buyer guides, comparisons and product pages — written by the company's sales-engineering, RF / production engineering and quality-control functions, not by named individuals.
bio: The Proud Tek Editorial Team is the institutional byline used on every editorial article on proudtek.com. Content is drafted by the functions that run buyer programmes — international sales engineering, RF / production engineering and quality control — and every technical claim is checked against the standard, chip-vendor datasheet or regulation cited in the article's sources block before publication. Following the same disclosure model as our sister brand RFIDAK, we credit functions rather than individuals: the people behind the byline change with the topic, and a byline that names a role is one a buyer can actually hold us to. The team also runs the corrections process described on /about/corrections/.
